library(tidyverse)
library(moderndive)

data("early_january_weather")  # loads the dataset
skimr::skim(early_january_weather)

#There are 15 variables in this data set

#Variable names 
names(early_january_weather)
#The names of the variables are  "origin"     "year"       "month"      "day"        "hour"       "temp"       "dewp"       "humid" "wind_dir"   "wind_speed"    "wind_gust"  "precip"     "pressure"   "visib"      "time_hour". #number of rows and columns
nrow(early_january_weather) #358 rows
ncol(early_january_weather) #15 columns

#mean temperature
mean(early_january_weather$temp, na.rm = TRUE) #mean temp is 39.58 Fahrenheit.
